meaning: A resolved implementation item is not a passed superiority claim. Negative evidence and conditional scope remain explicit.

items.criterion: Reproduce original boundary and values against independent numerical solutions
items.limit: Prior evidence retained byte-for-byte; not a theorem for every financial parameter.

items.criterion: A C1 second neural risk channel compatible with the full equity template
items.limit: Original F is modified in a boundary layer and mirrored on the danger side. This is not an original smooth-pasting put.

items.criterion: Stable float32 full-formula-derived values and neural state gradients
items.limit: Fourteen cases; controlled Hermite approximation; nine financial parameters fixed. Original raw float32 failures retained.

items.criterion: Use complete-model operators in actual neural-network training
items.limit: Neural weights/boundary learnable; finance parameters and table fixed.

items.criterion: Reproducible gradients, bounded state updates and reliable training timing
items.limit: No universal long-time BPTT bound or nonlinear ODE-flow claim. Original tiny-step float32 solve FD failures remain in stress_solve_results.json.

items.criterion: Complete-HX memory accuracy at least 95 percent for every seed and 32/64/128 length
items.observed: FullHX seed2 length128 93.84765625 percent; mean98.76953125 percent cannot substitute for the per-seed threshold.

items.criterion: Four-item retrieval at least 90 percent for every seed and length
items.observed: FullHX, toy, sigmoid and ridge-memory-only all100 percent for5seeds at32/64/128. Attribution is to associative memory, not uniquely the financial operators.

items.criterion: Unrestricted duration, associative capacity and robustness
items.limit: V3 fails duration/capacity shifts. Separate v4 challenges do not establish arbitrary length or capacity.

items.criterion: New frozen-encoder tasks, ordinary gate ablations and true raw-input missingness
items.limit: AG News and CIFAR10; not paired multimodal alignment, audio or real continuous-event inputs.

items.criterion: Stable quality gains attributable to financial operator shapes
items.observed: Complete HX versus same-graph sigmoid has small inconsistent mean differences; ordinary memory and linear controls remain competitive.

items.criterion: Measured full encoder-plus-head inference path and corrected cost accounting
items.limit: Shared CPU block timing; not a statistically controlled equal-quality cost or energy comparison.

items.criterion: Equal-quality scale curves, GPU/energy and full-backbone pretraining
items.limit: The user made expansion conditional on prior results. No established attributable quality benefit and a failed primary memory target.

items.criterion: Boundary-only multilayer communication, exact nonlinear continuous-time flow and spiking phase transitions
items.limit: Current trainable graph uses input-dependent neural offsets plus fast/slow/memory readout and discrete event updates.
